And the site/index.html already contains: - `Skip to main content` as the first element in body - `
` with the proper ID The colophon.html also already has an accessibility section that mentions keyboard accessibility. Since the accessibility improvement is complete, the next small improvement should be to **add a skip link to the other HTML pages** (colophon.html, contribute.html, how-it-works.html, license.html, updates.html, log.html) for consistency. This is purely additive - adding a skip link and CSS rule. - No existing markup, IDs, or JS is altered. - The HTML file count stays the same. - The inline style in index.html could be moved to styles.css for consistency, but that's a minor cleanup.
